About the College
Tyagbir Hem Baruah College, nestled in the serene town of Karchantola, Jamugurihat, Sonitpur, Assam, 
            stands as a testament to the pursuit of knowledge and the celebration of natural beauty. Established in 1963, 
            this educational institute has carved a niche for itself in the academic landscape of the region, offering a 
            harmonious blend of education and the picturesque surroundings. The sprawling campus is adorned with lush 
            greenery, creating an atmosphere conducive to learning and intellectual exploration.
Read More
Tyagbir Hem Baruah College's Motto
"May the Divine Light Enlighten Us"
01
VISION
Tyagbir Hem Baruah College envisions becoming a beacon of academic excellence, fostering innovation, 
                    ethical leadership, and holistic development.
Read More
02
MISSION
To provide a transformative and inclusive educational experience, Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is committed 
                    to nurturing intellectual curiosity, promoting academic excellence, and fostering holistic development. 
                    Through innovative teaching, research initiatives, and community engagement, we aim to empower our students 
                    with the skills, values, and global perspectives necessary to thrive in an ever-evolving world.
03
Objectives
To generate and transmit quality education and provide specialized education to students for gainful employment.
To impart education for inculcation of democratic and secular values and commitment towards society.
To strengthen national integration, universal brotherhood, and preservation of cultural heritage.
To inculcate the spirit of sportsmanship to attain perfection as human beings.
04
CORE VALUES
Integrity:
Good relationship and ethical reputation with students, faculty, employees, community, government, and other institutions.
Excellence:
Consistently achieving exceptional outcomes that delight students.
Communication:
Maintaining positive, innovative, and productive relationships.
Adaptability:
Continuously monitoring changing needs of students to enhance learning.
Diversity:
Providing a safe and secure learning environment for personal and intellectual growth.
